entries.title: Antivirus scan started
entries.what: A Microsoft Defender scan started.

entries.title: Antivirus scan finished
entries.what: A Microsoft Defender scan finished.

entries.title: Antivirus scan stopped
entries.what: A scan was stopped before it finished.

entries.title: Antivirus scan failed
entries.what: A Microsoft Defender scan failed. The message contains the error.
fix: Update definitions and run the scan again

entries.title: Malware or unwanted software found
entries.what: Microsoft Defender found malware or potentially unwanted software. The message names the threat and file.
causes: Potentially unwanted app bundled with an installer
fix: Open Windows Security > Protection history and check the action taken
Run a full scan
If it keeps coming back, find how it gets in (startup items, scheduled tasks, browser extensions)

entries.title: Action taken against malware
entries.what: Microsoft Defender quarantined, removed or allowed a detected item.

entries.title: Action against malware failed
entries.what: Microsoft Defender could not remove or quarantine a threat.
fix: Run Microsoft Defender Offline scan from Windows Security

entries.title: Threat detected
entries.what: Microsoft Defender detected malware or potentially unwanted software.
causes: Infected download, email attachment or USB drive
fix: Check Windows Security > Protection history
Run a full scan
Change passwords if the threat was a password stealer

entries.title: Action taken against threat
entries.what: Microsoft Defender acted against a detected threat (quarantine, remove, allow).

entries.title: Action against threat failed (non-critical)
entries.what: Microsoft Defender could not act against a threat.
fix: Run Microsoft Defender Offline scan

entries.title: Critical error acting against threat
entries.what: Microsoft Defender hit a critical error while acting against a threat.
fix: Run Microsoft Defender Offline scan
Consider a second-opinion scanner

entries.title: Defender is healthy
entries.what: Periodic heartbeat: Microsoft Defender is running and healthy.

entries.title: Defender health report
entries.what: Periodic health report from Microsoft Defender.

entries.title: Antivirus definitions updated
entries.what: Microsoft Defender security intelligence was updated.

entries.title: Antivirus definitions update failed
entries.what: Microsoft Defender could not update its definitions.
fix: Update manually from Windows Security
Check connectivity to Microsoft update servers

entries.title: Dynamic signature used
entries.what: Defender used a cloud-delivered (dynamic) signature. Normal.

entries.title: Real-time protection failed
entries.what: A real-time protection feature of Microsoft Defender failed.
fix: Restart; update Windows
Check for other antivirus products installed

entries.title: Real-time protection turned off
entries.what: Microsoft Defender real-time protection was disabled.
causes: User or policy turned it off
fix: If no other antivirus is installed, turn real-time protection back on and investigate why it was disabled

entries.title: Real-time protection configuration changed
entries.what: A real-time protection setting changed.

entries.title: Defender configuration changed
entries.what: A Microsoft Defender setting changed. Exclusions added here are worth a look.
fix: Review new exclusions

entries.title: Scanning for malware disabled
entries.what: Scanning for malware and unwanted software was disabled.
fix: Re-enable and investigate

entries.title: Virus scanning disabled
entries.what: Scanning for viruses was disabled.
fix: Re-enable and investigate

entries.title: Tamper protection blocked a change
entries.what: Tamper protection stopped a change to Microsoft Defender settings. Something tried to weaken protection.
causes: Software trying to change Defender settings
fix: Identify the program that tried to change settings

entries.title: Attack surface reduction rule blocked something
entries.what: An attack surface reduction (ASR) rule blocked an action.
fix: Review the blocked program; add exclusion only if it is legitimate

entries.title: Controlled folder access blocked an app
entries.what: An app was blocked from changing files in protected folders (ransomware protection).
fix: Allow the app in Windows Security only if you trust it

entries.title: Security Center service started
entries.what: The Windows Security Center service started.

entries.title: Antivirus status updated
entries.what: Security Center recorded the status of an antivirus product (e.g. enabled).
